task_title: P2 — node-create.sh stages project-node.sh without scripts/disk_floor.py so every documented node creation dies on its first line (and leaves the spawned agent alive)
task_criteria: CF-075: node-create.sh must stage every file project-node.sh executes at runtime (scripts/disk_floor.py included) so the documented node-creation path no longer dies on a raw interpreter error, and a failed provision must not leave the spawned agent alive. Grade at the judged commit by running: (1) bash -n scripts/node-create.sh scripts/project-node.sh tests/selftest.sh exits 0; (2) grep -c disk_floor.py scripts/node-create.sh is greater than 0 AND the staged set is derived with a check that exits nonzero when a file project-node.sh references via $HERE is missing from it; (3) bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and its output contains a new staged-set fixture that stages exactly node-create.sh declared staged set into a temp dir, shows NO "can't open file" interpreter error and DOES show a named disk-floor row; (4) the negative control with disk_floor.py removed from that staged copy FAILs with a countable FAIL row naming the disk floor instead of a raw interpreter error; (5) node-create.sh destroys the agent it spawned on a FAIL provisioning run, or prints the exact bunker destroy <id> --server <host> command (mutating bunker commands must not rely on the default-server fallback); (6) the commit message carries "Addresses CF-075." and a ch:trace line naming row=CF-075. Not graded: live-host node creation (no host required for this row) and any repair of other board rows.
